decision.reason: [ev-cd857bf3470c] is only a one-line PR title in the GitHub release's "What's Changed" list, and it mostly points to PR #6685. It says Crossplane may now merge existing MRDs with provider MRDs. It doesn't say which fields get merged, how the behavior differed before, which installations (for example, ones with existing MRDs) are exposed, or what happens to an operator who does nothing. To write the typed assertion, we need the PR description or diff, or upgrade-guide text that states the merge behavior and its before/after.
